about 20 feet and is nearly 10 feet tall.  It looks very old.
The immense spider web moves softly.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the spider web

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside a cave-like structure that seems to be made entirely from
countless layers of spider web.  Temperature and humidity is very high making
it hard to breathe the foul air that lingers here.  The walls are covered with
open cocoons.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Compared to this place the east exit looks inviting.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6134 to 6133

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The cocoons are burst open as if something inside really wanted to get out.
They are at the size of a human head.
The sticky walls are covered with open cocoons.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Den of the Queen Spider

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom all around you.  The trail continues north and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dusty trail leads north through the trees.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6135 to 6136

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dusty trail leads east through the trees.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6135 to 6129

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A dusty trail in the deep, dark forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient,
grey trees loom everywhere.  The trail continues south and west.  A broad
irregular path leads eastwards away from the trail.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6136 to 6142

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dusty trail leads south through the trees.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6136 to 6135

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dusty trail leads west through the trees.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6136 to 6137

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in
some places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.
The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.

To the east the ancient grey giants have many marks as if something with huge
claws has been tearing at them in rage.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A dusty trail in the deep, dark forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom all around you.  You see a dark grove north of you.
The only other exit is east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a dark grove north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6137 to 1300

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dusty trail leads east through the trees.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6137 to 6136

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: At the end of the trail through the deep, dark forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are at the end of a broad, irregular path.  To the north is a very large
ominous-looking cave opening.  The trees here have many marks as if something
with huge claws has been tearing at them in rage.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6142 to 6143

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The path winds its way westwards.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6142 to 6136

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.

The ancient grey giants have many marks as if something with huge claws has
been tearing at them in rage.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Outside a cave in the deep, dark forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a big natural cave.  The floor is littered with bones of all sorts
and the stench is so massive that you could cut it with a knife.  The only exit
is to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The exit leads out into the forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6143 to 6142

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: Most of the bones on the floor appear to be of human origin.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The cave of the Green Dragon

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient,
grey trees loom everywhere.  The tree trunks here seem to be covered in some
sticky substance.  The path continues south and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6144 to 6110

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6144 to 6130

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The path seems all too frail.  One of the giant roots could probably crush it
in a single blow.
The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.

The substance reminds you of giant threads covered with glue.  If it had not
been for the size you could have sworn it was part of a spider web.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A small path in the deep, dark forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This trail looks much spookier than any other thats you have seen.  The usual
animal claw marks and bites on the trees are getting far and few between. The
trail continues north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the narrow trail continues north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6150 to 6151

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the trail intersects the main forest path.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6150 to 6103

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The narrow trail.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This area of the trail is also very peculiar.  You can see no signs of animal
life what so ever.  The structure of the surrounding trees forces the path to
make a sharp turn to the east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the trail bends east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6151 to 6152

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the start of the trail.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6151 to 6150

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The narrow trail.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The trees here seem to form a circle around a HUGE tree that is in the center
of them.  You notice a wooden door carved into the huge tree to the east.  The
trail that you followed to get here seems to end at the base of the tree.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tree door is carved beautifully.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 6152 to 6153

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the bend on the trail.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6152 to 6151

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The circle of trees.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have stepped inside of this hollowed tree.  From here steps lead down into
darkness or you can exit the tree by going west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the door is carved beautifully.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 6153 to 6152

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The steps look appear like they will hold your weight.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6153 to 6154

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Inside the great tree.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This hallway is apparently one of the roots of the tree hollowed out.  The hall
leads south to a room where you hear strange noises or you can go up the steps.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the hallway looks quite grand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6154 to 6155

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the steps appear like they will hold your weight.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6154 to 6153

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The underground hallway.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This temple is built to some god that you don't worship.  It is a nice place
to visit but you feel very uncomfortable about spending much time here.
The wooden altar seems almost to glow as you enter the room.  The only exit is
the way you came in.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: the hallway looks quite grand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  6155 to 6154

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The cultist temple.
